# pbs_remote (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server remote: another PBS that sync jobs pull backups from or push them to, with the credentials to sign in there. A `pbs_sync_job` names it in `remote`.

PBS contacts nothing when it saves a remote: a wrong host, port, fingerprint or password shows only when a sync job runs, or when the `pbs_remote_datastores` data source scans the remote, which signs in to it.

Sign in with an API token on the remote rather than a password, with only the privileges the sync jobs need there, on `/datastore/<store>` of the remote — a `pbs_acl` on the remote grants them: to pull, the role `DatastoreReader` (or `DatastoreBackup`, which reads the token's own backups only); to push, `DatastoreBackup`, or `DatastorePowerUser` for `remove_vanished`, and `Datastore.Modify`, which `DatastoreAdmin` has, for a push that creates namespaces there.

~> **PBS refuses to delete a remote a sync job uses.** When a change of `name` replaces a remote that a `pbs_sync_job` uses, set `lifecycle { create_before_destroy = true }` on the remote, so that the job moves to the new remote before the old one goes.

Managing remotes needs `Remote.Modify` on `/remote`, or on `/remote/<name>` for an existing one; reading them `Remote.Audit`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The offsite PBS, as a remote of the PBS that holds the backups, so that a
# pbs_sync_job can push to it. On the offsite server, an API token,
# sync@pbs!primary here, signs the pushes in; it needs DatastoreBackup on the
# offsite datastore, for the token and its user both.
resource "pbs_remote" "offsite" {
  name    = "offsite"
  host    = "pbs-offsite.example.com"
  auth_id = "sync@pbs!primary"
  comment = "Offsite copy"

  # The offsite server's self-signed certificate, as its dashboard or
  # pbs_fingerprint there shows it. Leave it out for a certificate of a
  # public CA.
  fingerprint = "2f:f2:f7:e9:8b:a5:62:fe:bb:6d:63:40:33:8b:4a:97:e6:d4:80:5d:f9:96:b9:63:ee:4c:08:31:c2:d0:00:5c"

  # The token's secret is write-only: it never reaches the plan or state, and
  # PBS receives it when the remote is created and whenever
  # password_wo_version changes.
  password_wo         = var.offsite_token_secret
  password_wo_version = 1
}

variable "offsite_token_secret" {
  description = "Secret of the API token sync@pbs!primary on the offsite PBS."
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
  ephemeral   = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `auth_id` (String) User or API token to sign in to the remote as, such as `sync@pbs` or `sync@pbs!offsite`.
- `host` (String) DNS name or IP address of the remote, without a port; an IPv6 address goes without brackets.
- `name` (String) Remote name, 3 to 32 characters: letters, digits, `_`, `.` and `-`, not starting with `.` or `-`. Sync jobs name it in `remote`, and ACL paths in `/remote/<name>`. Changing it replaces the remote.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `comment` (String) Free-form comment, up to 128 characters on one line.
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA-256 fingerprint of the remote's certificate, such as the `fingerprint` of the `pbs_fingerprint` data source on the remote: 64 hexadecimal digits, optionally separated by colons, in either case. PBS then accepts the certificate with this fingerprint, as a self-signed one needs; a certificate its system's CAs validate it accepts either way, so the fingerprint is no pin against those. When left out, PBS accepts only certificates its CAs validate. The fingerprint changes with the certificate, so update it when the remote's certificate is renewed or replaced.
- `password_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Password of `auth_id` on the remote, or, when `auth_id` is an API token, the token's secret. PBS needs it to create the remote, so it is required then; after an import, leave it out to keep the password PBS has. Write-only: Terraform passes it to PBS without storing it in the plan or state, and PBS never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform goes unnoticed. PBS receives it when the object is created and whenever `password_wo_version` changes. Requires `password_wo_version`, and Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later.
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Version of `password_wo`, which Terraform stores in its place. Change it — increment it, say — to send a new `password_wo`; removing it, with `password_wo`, leaves the value on the server as it is. Requires `password_wo`.
- `port` (Number) Port of the remote's API; 8007, PBS's own, when left out.
- `use_node_proxy` (Boolean) Whether PBS connects to the remote through the HTTP proxy of its node configuration. Defaults to `false`, a direct connection. `true` needs PBS 4.2 or newer.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same value as `name`, present because Terraform requires an `id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_remote.offsite
  identity = {
    name = "offsite"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) Remote name, such as `offsite`.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = pbs_remote.offsite
  id = "offsite"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Remotes are imported by name. PBS never returns the password, so
# password_wo_version is empty after an import, and a configuration that sets
# it sends password_wo in the next apply, replacing the password PBS has.
terraform import pbs_remote.offsite offsite
```
